subject.title: macOS chat window: native redesign with sessions sidebar, toolbar pickers, slash commands, context usage

question: Should the macOS chat redesign proceed through the linked native-shell PR after its blockers are fixed, be narrowed into smaller parity-first PRs, or be deferred?
rationale: The request adds a broad native macOS product surface and transport behavior under a protected `maintainer` label, and the linked PR is not merged, so maintainer intent is required before implementation or closure.

options.title: Narrow And Review Linked PR
options.body: Resolve the linked PR’s blockers and focus the first landing path on sessions sidebar/create, command autocomplete, context usage, and core session actions with inspectable macOS proof.

options.title: Sponsor Full Native Shell
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the larger native shell scope and review burden if full web-parity direction is desired now.

options.title: Defer Redesign
options.body: Keep the current compact Mac chat surface and defer the redesign if this product area is not ready to sponsor.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Review Linked PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR’s blockers and focus the first landing path on sessions sidebar/create, command autocomplete, context usage, and core session actions with inspectable macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the tracker and authored the linked candidate implementation, so they are the best available owner for the product-scope choice.
